|---|---|
| logo SVG (the dashed edge is brand, never a legend symbol) | `sig.brand-mark/1` in `lib/brand.ts` — three nodes, two solid edges, exactly one dashed edge (`dasharray 6 4`), one ink, badge-free; `LogoMark.astro` renders it `aria-hidden` in `currentColor` inside the wordmark; the e2e leg proves the brand dash appears nowhere outside the glyph — on a T1 dossier AND on the T2 network surface whose epistemic legend keeps its own dash styles |
| favicon set | `public/favicon.svg` IS the mark on the ink tile (byte-pinned to `renderFaviconSvg`); `favicon-32.png` + `apple-touch-icon.png` rasterised from it at build time; `brand/logo.svg` — the standalone ink-on-transparent file |
| per-type social cards built at build time | `sig.social-card/1` — one card per registered page type minus T3 (`SOCIAL_CARDS`, resolved per-route via `classifyRoute`); the `sig-brand-assets` `astro:build:done` hook renders each `renderCardSvg` → 1200×630 PNG via `sharp` (Astro's own image dep — no new package); the card's "Data as of" reads the same `getSiteMetadata()` the pages read |
| meta descriptions per page type | `defaultDescription(title, type)` — the T1 form is copy row MD-01 verbatim; T0 names the fixed no-JS page, T2 the interactive surface; unique per page because the title is unique; the standalone print head passes its real T0 type |
| OG/Twitter head block | `BaseLayout` + `print.astro` emit og:type/site_name/title/description/url/image + dimensions + `og:image:alt` and twitter:card/title/description/image on every public route; T3 emits none |

## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **`sharp` is imported statically in `astro.config.mjs`.** The first
   draft dynamic-imported it inside `astro:build:done` — Vite's module
   runner is already torn down by then ("Vite module runner has been
   closed"). A top-level `import sharp from "sharp"` survives; it is
   Astro's own image-pipeline dependency — same class as the config's
   existing `esbuild` import — so **no new dependency is added**.
2. **The standalone print head needed the block too.** Print dossiers
   (`dossier/[...path]/print.astro`) build their own `<head>`, not
   `BaseLayout` — the per-route sweeps flagged them. The print head
   now emits the same favicon links + OG/Twitter block with the route's
   real T0 type (its `link rel=canonical` still names the dossier for
   indexers; `og:url` names the print route itself — the shared object).
3. **`"/>` in emitted SVG strings read as four root-absolute "sites".**
   The `check-root-absolute-paths` counter matched the `"/>` self-close
   sequence inside the renderer's template literals; the tags now
   emit `" />` so the measured tree holds at the committed baseline
   (134) rather than growing on a regex artefact — and the favicon's
   byte-pin moved with it.
4. **`ops/public_routes.toml` gained four rows.** `test_publish.py`'s
   `assert_allowlisted_tree` refused `apple-touch-icon.png`, `brand/`,
   `favicon-32.png`, `social/` — the allow-list edit is the publish
   decision for emitted assets (the P34.13 precedent). All four are
   `required` — the hook emits them on every build and a silent drop
   must refuse.
5. **No ADR.** Every shape executes already-answered decision lines
   (`D-K14-2 = yes` verbatim; K14 §4.12's mark/card/description rules;
   DR-K14-20's per-type card set; ADR-155's page-type posture;
   MD-01's description template extended per type, not replaced).
6. **`og:url` names the route itself, uniformly.** On print routes the
   `link rel=canonical` stays the dossier (indexer semantics) while
   the shared object is the print URL — one rule, no special cases,
   asserted across all 38 public routes.
